name: ANOVA (one-way / factorial) and post-hoc (Tukey)
when_to_use: Compare the means of three or more groups at once; metric dependent variable, one or more categorical factors; post-hoc (Tukey) shows which pairs differ.
notes: Same group comparison as the t-test, but for three or more groups at once, then showing which pairs differ from each other. Applications: compare 4 sales regions; compare 3 versions of a product.

expected_input.question: Do the means of three or more groups differ, and which pairs?

pdca_use: Check phase: compare the same indicator across three or more units/shifts/periods at once, with post-hoc showing which pairs differ — closed-form calculation, no model selection.

plain_explanation.purpose: Checks whether three or more groups have truly different means.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When comparing several versions, classes or regions on a number.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A numeric column and a group column with 3+ categories.
plain_explanation.example: Compare the average sales of 4 regions.
plain_explanation.diagram: A  B  C  D -> does any mean stand out? -> which ones?
